title: Dinner at Home
text:
Every evening, my family eats dinner together at home. My mother makes rice and beans. My father makes a big salad. I like to drink water with my meal. We talk about our day while we eat.

After dinner, we wash the dishes. My sister dries the plates and puts them away. Then we eat a small piece of cake. Dinner is my favourite time of the day.

questions.text: What does the narrator's mother make for dinner?
What does the narrator's sister do after dinner?
How does the narrator feel about dinner?
options: He thinks it is his favourite time of the day
He is always angry at dinner
He does not like to eat with his family

questions.text: What can we infer about the family's dinners?
options: They are very short and quiet
They are a time to spend together
They are always in a restaurant

vocabulary.definition: the main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening
a cold dish made of raw vegetables
the plates, cups and bowls used for eating and drinking
a sweet food made from flour, eggs and sugar, baked in an oven

paragraph_translations: Todas as noites, minha família janta junta em casa. Minha mãe faz arroz e feijão. Meu pai faz uma salada grande. Eu gosto de beber água com a minha refeição. Nós conversamos sobre o nosso dia enquanto comemos.
Depois do jantar, nós lavamos a louça. Minha irmã seca os pratos e os guarda. Depois, comemos um pedaço pequeno de bolo. O jantar é a minha hora favorita do dia.
